reference: MAME 0.276 assistant clone; Apollo DN3500; Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01

test.initial_guest: File Manager on /node_12345, 28 files and 2 filtered, four-column XmpIcon grid
test.action: A single held host click on blank desktop area was used to arm the existing mouse hook; the click did not target an icon or menu.
test.result: Hook reported captured=true, mouse=true, device=mouse, wait_button_up=false, transitions=9. The native screenshot shows the same File Manager grid without a selected icon.

limits: This verifies hook capture on the blank-area click only. It produces no XmpIcon selection, focus, hover or rubberband pair for GTK2.
cleanup: The hook was later explicitly released; the current live check confirms captured=false, mouse=false, mouse_device=none, paused=false, frameskip=4, throttled=false.
